messages:
alex: 08:12 UTC — customers reporting bursts of 502/504s hitting hosted-api generate (streaming). spike across us-west/us-east. lots of conn resets. sample traces: abc123, def456. paging SRE — @maria @jay please help

jia: which endpoint exactly — embeddings or generation? any recent deploys?

alex: generation (v2/generate) with stream=true. no deploy in last 2hrs. started ~08:11. affected tenants acct-847, acct-999. curl repro I ran:

alex: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","stream":true}'```

sre-bot: ALERT: Frontdoor 502 spike >5% at 2024-11-05T08:12:30Z; top upstream error=ECONNRESET (count 324)

maria: grabbing envoy logs now, posting key lines

maria: ```[2024-11-05T08:12:14.123Z] upstream reset: connection failure, last downstream bytes sent=0, reset_reason=RST_STREAM
[2024-11-05T08:12:15.789Z] HTTP/2 stream 0 closed with error code 11 (Refused stream)
[2024-11-05T08:12:16.001Z] envoy: upstream connection pool overflow, new connection -> 502 returned```

jay: that pattern smells like connection-pool exhaustion — Envoy returns 502 on new streams when pool is saturated. any changes to keepalive/idle windows or auth cache flushes?

alex: we rotated auth-cache TTL at 08:10 (shorter TTL to force refresh). also seeing a lot of long-lived streaming jobs (bulk-embeddings customers) at same time.

maria: repro I ran: fire 50 concurrent streaming requests with large initial payloads -> proxy returns 502 within ~30s. script I used:

maria: ```for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"aaaaa...","stream":true}' & done; wait```

jay: temporary mitigation options: 1) bump ingress upstream_conn_limit and keepalive_timeout, 2) enable tenant-level rate limit/backpressure, 3) avoid auth cache full flush during bursts. Ops — can we roll a canary? :thumbsup:

ops: starting canary rollout for connection pool bump on ingress group A. patch changes: `upstream_connections: 1024 -> 2048`, `keepalive_timeout: 30s -> 90s`. monitoring.

alex: customers want ETA on full rollout and interim workaround.

maria: canary stable for 20m now — error rate down from 6.2% -> 0.8% in group A. planning full rollout in ~30m after verification window. also prepping hotfix for auth-cache TTL race (PR incoming).

jay: opened long-term fix PR to add backpressure when auth-cache invalidation occurs and avoid global flush under high stream concurrency. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/8342

alex: fyi I'm sending interim note to affected customers: we've identified connection saturation + auth-cache rotation as root cause; mitigations in progress.

maria: postmortem draft notes: root cause = upstream connection pool exhaustion + auth-cache flush -> burst of upstream resets -> Envoy/ingress returned 502/504 to clients. Mitigations: increase pool, throttle tenant streaming concurrency, avoid full cache flush on rotation, and backfill better observability for long-lived streams. :white_check_mark:

ops: full rollout completed at 08:52 UTC, monitoring looks good (error rate <1%). closing unless we see regression.

alex: thanks all — passing update to customers and support channels.

maria: follow-up: will add synthetic test that simulates long-lived streams + cache rotation to catch this in staging. tagging for postmortem action items in #eng-sre.

ops: closing thread — reopen if alerts spike again.
